sampling_method: Native runtime samples only; frame_ms is the matching raw frame interval at each emitted sample. Visible fixture-anchor observations join the independent mmap/scalar projection CSV by exact sample time and anchor ID. Off-screen/raw probes remain in the source runtime and projection CSV. The two overview-target waypoint observations are a separate derived camera-focus-to-viewport-center control point; the runtime emits no triangle probe for it, and it is not one of the nine hashed A05 data anchors. A later generic raw record at the exact final-waypoint timestamp is omitted from this ordered adapter; the original raw record remains intact and the decision is listed in conversion-binding.json.
warmup_description: Keep startup and prewarm frames in the sample stream. memory_mb uses the nearest observed process RSS sample; the exact run peak is attached to its nearest renderer sample if sampling instants differ. See conversion-binding.json.
